purpose: Three reference stills for director selection; not production layers or approved designs.
A:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE premium cinematic 16:9 art-direction reference still for Swarm Song, a world imagined and assembled by an exceptionally imaginative child, executed with the composition and lighting of a master animation art director. Nighttime GPU metropolis built from layers of cut construction paper, corrugated cardboard edges, watercolor/crayon marks, small imperfect tape joins, shallow dimensional overlap shadows. Buildings are inhabited apartment architecture inspired by GPUs: incorporated paper fan rosettes, heat-sink balconies, copper trim, chip-like rooftops, little gold connector foundations. Warm varied amber apartment windows, tiny curtains and cozy lamplight inside, deep indigo and muted teal exteriors. Childlike authorship and beautifully irregular hand-cut craft, sophisticated restrained lighting. Flat illustrated paper faces with tactile shallow 2.5D depth; no glossy plastic, photoreal hardware, game UI or futuristic neon cyberpunk. No typography, letters, titles, logos, labels, border, watermark or visible characters. Compose visibly separable foreground, near neighborhood, middle neighborhood, far skyline, atmospheric sky layers, suitable for later independently authored parallax. This image is a concept still, not a layer diagram.
DIRECTION A — OVER THE ROOFTOPS. Camera is just cresting a foreground rooftop at blue hour/night, looking slightly downward across a rich valley of cardboard GPU apartment neighborhoods. Large cropped dark roof and fan housing at the lower-left foreground and a close roof at lower-right establish strong occlusion and scale. Behind these, many overlapping medium-height buildings form intimate irregular blocks along a softly curving circuit street that leads the eye to a warm distinctive GPU apartment complex in the right middle distance. Several rows of buildings recede into desaturated violet tissue-paper haze; the distant skyline occupies the upper third beneath a deep ink-blue paper sky. Strong visual reveal: near roofs would slide rapidly past the camera, midground slowly, far city barely moves. An entire civilization revealed beyond one roof, romantic lofi warmth and wonder. Contrast large foreground silhouettes with dense tiny distant windows. Crisp paper craft on hero planes, understated detail at distance. Maintain atmospheric depth without blurring away the paper identity. Make the frame feel like a gorgeous opening shot, not an asset display.

DIRECTION C — THE CITY OPENS BETWEEN THE BUILDINGS. Make this composition distinctly different from an elevated panorama. A low, intimate, street-level camera looking slightly upward through a dense canyon of lovingly crooked paper apartment buildings. Strong multi-plane theatrical cut-paper staging: enormous cropped near-black navy facade and heat-sink silhouette on the left edge, another close layered facade along the right edge, near-midground tightly overlapping terracotta and dusty-sage GPU apartment buildings stepping inward, a small warm pocket courtyard at the bend, taller indigo buildings rising behind, and tiny faint high-rise silhouettes beyond. Buildings fill most of the frame; only a narrow upper-center wedge of dark velvety paper sky, NO moon or landscape mountains. Multiple successive overlapping silhouettes and dramatic size changes create rich parallax potential, as though the camera is slowly moving between buildings then lifting to discover the larger city. Copper circuit lanes are delicate, embedded in irregular paper pavement, curving around the courtyard and disappearing behind the next block. Every structure meets the ground; contact shadows and small pools of lamplight establish weight. Warm windows scattered with asymmetry, some dark, curtains and little domestic lamps; one three-window apartment stack in right middle distance is especially inviting. GPU identity integrated variously into roof fans, side fan housings and corrugated heat-sink balconies, not the same huge fan stamped on every facade. Emphasize a sophisticated illustrated MULTIPLANE PAPER-CUT SET: broad matte colored-paper shapes, layered edges, crayon touches, collage surface and purposeful gentle shadows, rather than a photograph of a model town. Quiet nocturnal wonder, a child's tactile invention seen with beautiful film lighting. Crisp foreground cut edges, gentle atmospheric separation behind.
